scope: Educational 3D potential-flow panels coupled one-way to nominal spatial-beam stress, plus independent inviscid 2D airfoil analysis. No viscous/stall or local solid stress. Unresolved torque/twist withheld; unsuitable cases refused.

features: Compact Aerodynamics and Structure & Stress input panels
Upper/lower surface Cp and pressure contours
Sectional Cp and spanwise lift curves
Coefficient, convergence and admission tables
Aerodynamic CSV and PNG exports
Rotatable 3D Cp and pressure on the actual aerodynamic panel surface
Optional visible panel boundaries in 3D and 2D
Signed blue-green-red scale with green at zero
On-screen aerodynamic mesh-stage progress and elapsed time
Independent aerodynamic results for exact zero-chord elliptic and delta tips
Full wing mirror in the View menu
Open and Save JSON in File
Two-spar course example with bonded module seams
Structural solve and result-contour activity feedback
Airfoils & planform first in the wing context menu
Full-range pressure colour contrast with linear and manual range options
Explicit hatching and counts for pressure panels outside manual colour limits
Expandable per-mesh pressure-extrema sensitivity check
LE/TE and flow markers on the 3D pressure surface
Signed sectional Cp with suction at the top
Section lift coefficient, circulation, moment and trailing-edge Cp difference graphs
Unified current-figure PNG and aerodynamic CSV commands in File
Lightweight anatomy switching and paused hidden structural rendering
Independent 2D section panel solver with selected/half-density Cp curves, cl and quarter-chord cm
2D PNG/CSV exports and clickable Cp/tangential-speed probes
Explicit amber/dashed local tip-uncertainty samples without clipping values
Step-by-step panel algorithm, equations and accuracy Help
